fidelityReview.notes: Individual medium-fi Little Hagia Sophia exterior: mixed brick/stone low body and projecting eastern apse, raised buttressed brick drum, shallow grey lead central dome, western five-bay round-arched open portico with five small roof domes, pale single-balcony minaret and green side door. Exact main outline retained; all internal partitions, heights, roof plans and tower position are estimates. Six existing shared 256² graphs, seven merged roles and four budgeted browser LODs. Separate tomb, cemetery, school, city, fine ornament and furnished interiors remain outside this asset. No retained or current map height values exist. Visualization estimates: main eaves 11.8 m; raised sixteen-sided brick drum/buttresses from 12–19.2 m; shallow lead-covered central dome 19.2–23.4 m and finial 24.8 m. Portico capitals 4.9 m, round arches to 6.8 m, roof/cornice 7.8 m and five small shallow domes to about 9.4 m. Single minaret: square base 7 m, tapering pale shaft to 23 m, projecting balcony around 23–24.2 m, smaller upper shaft to 28 m, conical lead cap to 31.4 m and finial 32 m. All these vertical dimensions, roof profiles, small finials, window rhythms and the exact tower origin are explicit picture-led approximations, not surveyed facts. Fine stone capitals, historic brick lattice, calligraphy and unseen interiors omitted. Two useful actually inspected Commons pictures guide the signed portico/drum/apse forms. A near-duplicate courtyard picture 3296 supplied no extra control. Both courtyard pictures crop the tower top; the wider opposite-side view supplies the dome/roof profile and visible minaret cone. There are no independent current or retained heights or roof/minaret plans. Dome/finial 24.8 m and minaret finial 32 m are visualization estimates above the working floor. Fine artwork, exact current finish, engineering, interiors and physical-device timings remain unverified.
